part_number.note: 21-character Model Option Table string. Prefix '0787L' occupies positions 1-5. Positions 7 (Extended IO), 10 (Slot C), 12 (Slot D), 14 (Slot E) and 16 (Slot Z voltage) are anchored by the master-drawing layers and were re-confirmed against the pixel-measured MOT columns and three real part numbers from the 787L instruction manual. LAYER-ANCHOR CORRECTIONS: the drawing 'SLOT_B_PORTS' group was mis-anchored to position 8 (length 2) -- that digit is actually the Slot A power-supply voltage; Slot B communications is a SINGLE digit at position 19. Positions 8-9 (Slot A power supply / DI voltage), 18 (Front Panel), 20 (Protocol) and 21 (Conformal Coat) are not in the drawing layers and come from the ordering doc. Each I/O slot occupies 2 digits: card type then Digital Input Voltage (A=125, B=24, C=48, D=110, G=220, H=250 Vdc/Vac; X/0 = none). Slot Z (16-17) is a combined current+voltage code.
references: SEL-787L master configuration drawings i7239.B / i7294.B / i7296.C / i7297.B (drawing layers)
SEL-787L Instruction Manual (787L_IM_20250701) -- source of the real example part numbers

example_part_numbers.note: Real PN from the 787L IM: firmware 1 (Charging Current Comp, Fault Locator, etc.), English/Empty, 110-250 V PS, 125 V DI, Slot C 4 DI/4 DO EM, Slot D 10 RTD, Slot E empty, Slot Z 1 A phase/200 mA neutral + 3 AVI, 5-inch touchscreen, dual 10/100BASE-T, DNP3.

Real PN from the 787L IM: firmware None, 110-250 V PS, 24 V DI, Slot C 8 AI, Slot D 4 DI/4 DO EM, Slot E Vsync/Vbat/4 Arc-Flash, Slot Z 5 A phase/1 A neutral + 3 AVI, 2x16 LCD, single 10/100BASE-T, no protocol.

Real PN from the 787L IM: firmware 2 (CCC + Directional), 110-250 V PS, 125 V DI, Slot C 4 DI/4 DO EM, Slot D 10 RTD, Slot E empty, Slot Z 1 A/1 A + 3 AVI, 5-inch touchscreen, dual 100BASE-FX, all four protocols.

positions.note: Arc Sense technology for HIF detection applies to low-impedance grounded systems.
